blocker.reason: The official WFS states PagingIsTransactionSafe=false and returns at most 10,000 features per response. A paged public-service scrape cannot prove one coherent edition; the two official service count observations also differ for the cutblock layer.
blocker.requiredBeforeAcquisition: Submit and receive the publisher's BC Geographic Warehouse Custom Download export for each source, then record the delivered file's exact version/edition, retrieval completion, byte length, SHA-256, archive integrity, schema/geometry profile, and lifecycle review.
